person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and third person. Multiple interior Goodreads passages narrate Culum, Struan, Brock, and other characters externally, sometimes reporting private thought or sensation. The many visible instances of “I” and “you” occur in dialogue, direct thought, or maxims and therefore do not establish first- or second-person base narration. The permissioned opening independently shows a third-person narrator moving among several characters’ inner states, while the whole-book study guide explicitly confirms third-person point of view. Targeted searches found no epistolary frame or sustained first- or second-person sections. The authorized web excerpt covers only the opening, but the interior quote evidence and explicit whole-book description offset that scope limitation.
